Aggregate results for the choosing-metrics vignette.

The three reliability tables contain corpus/stratum estimates for the short
and long cohorts. Empty confidence limits mean the predeclared reporting rule
was not met; consult cluster counts and the largest cluster's share even when
limits are available. These are within-document single-block ICCs, not writer
ability or test-retest reliability.

block-densities.csv contains only the BAWE long-cohort distributions used by
the vignette. It uses a common bandwidth and evaluation range within each
measure. The complete aggregate tables, protocol, source acknowledgements and
reproduction scripts are in experiments/corpus-extension in the source repository.

No original text, token sequence, participant ID or document-level score table
is included. No corpus download occurs during installation or vignette rendering.
